role: Single-slot UserDefaults record of the most recent meaningful auto-rescore delta (prior/new score) so the dashboard can show a 'score changed' banner; posts a notification when written; reads drop notices older than 12 h or for another session.
types: PendingScoreChange.Entry: struct Codable — sessionId, priorScore, newScore (0-10 scale), reason, timestamp
toplevel: Entry gets synthesized Codable used by write/read. maxAge constant. Notification.Name extension declares pendingScoreChangeWritten.

units.does: JSON-encodes the Entry into UserDefaults key PendingScoreChange.v1 (overwriting any previous entry) and, only when that succeeded, posts .pendingScoreChangeWritten with the entry as object.

branches.effect: attempt() logs a warning; nothing is stored and no notification is posted

units.does: Returns the stored notice through read(currentSessionId: nil): decoded and no older than maxAge (12 h), else cleared and nil. No session check.

Reads and decodes the Entry from UserDefaults key PendingScoreChange.v1; returns it only when it is for currentSessionId (when given) and between 0 and maxAge (12 h) old at now. An undecodable, stale or other-session entry is cleared and nil returned.

branches.cond: no data stored under the key
decode fails (logged by attempt) or the entry is not current
branches.effect: clears the key and returns nil

units.does: Removes UserDefaults key PendingScoreChange.v1 (called when the dashboard banner is dismissed).
True when the entry's sessionId matches currentSessionId (or none is given) and its timestamp is 0…maxAge seconds before now.

branches.cond: a currentSessionId is given and differs from the entry's
age negative (clock moved back) or over maxAge
